$comment: EXP-1274: ONE empty state x4 (web @exp/ui EmptyState + lib/empty-states.ts, desktop controls::empty_state + empty_state_copy.rs, iOS ExpUI EmptyState + ExpCore EmptyStateCopy.swift, Android components EmptyState + domain EmptyStateCopy.kt). Two sizes: `page` = the 48px icon disc, a semibold title, an optional muted sentence and an optional actions row, centred on a column of at most 28rem with 48px vertical padding — what a whole screen or pane says when it has nothing. `list` = a bare 20px muted glyph over ONE muted 14px line, centred, 24px vertical padding — what a list inside a section, a sidebar or a picker says; it never carries a description or a button (except the Retry of a failed automatic load, feedback-states.json `errors.rule`) (the section band's trailing pill, or the picker's own field, IS the call to action). Copy rules: a title is at most four words — `No <noun> yet` for a list that will grow, `No <noun>` for a filter or search result, `All caught up` for the inbox — and never explains; a description exists only on `page`, only when it teaches the next step and that step is not a visible button; `action` names the page's primary button when the client can offer it (a phone without the capability shows the description instead). Icons are CONCEPTS (packages/icons/icons.json). `states` holds every empty state drawn by two or more clients; copy already locked by another contract stays there (issue search hint + no-match in lib/issue-search.ts, PR_GRAPH_OVERLAY_COPY, GUIDE_NO_CHANGES, picker emptyText). A list whose data is still loading shows a skeleton (web/desktop) or a centred spinner (phones) the FIRST time only; a later refetch spins the 12px loading glyph at the trailing edge of the list's section band instead (GlassSectionHeader loading x4). No list carries a Refresh control unless its source is external (GitHub, the local disk or git): synced lists are live, server-only lists refetch on entry, on return to the tab and after every write.
